source.title: Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Duterte

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: The Senate President, the Presiding Officer of the Impeachment Court, and the Senator-Judges.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Sgt. at Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Christopher Bongo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Almighty and loving God, O Allah, we come before you today with humility, mindful of the solemn duty entrusted to us and the weight of the decisions that lie ahead. Grant us wisdom to discern what is right, courage to uphold the truth and fairness in every judgment we make. Keep us from prejudice, Anger, personal interest, and political pressure. Help us listen with patience, speak with honesty, and act according to conscience, the Constitution, and the welfare of the Filipino people. Gabayanin niyo kaming lahat ng may tungkulin sa mga pagdinig na ito, naway ang bawat panig ay mabigyan ng pagkakataong marinig, ang bawat ebedensya ay mapag-aralang mabuti, at ang bawat pasya Ay nakabatay sa katotohanan, katarungan at tamang proseso. Remind us that public office is a sacred trust. May we never lose sight of the people whose lives are affected by our words, our actions, and our decisions. Let the pursuit of truth strengthen our institutions and deepen our commitment to serve with integrity and compassion.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: Lord, bring healing to our nation. Where there is division, grant us understanding, patience, and unity. Where there is distrust, restore faith. Where there is fear and anger, give us calmness and restraint. When these proceedings are concluded, help us move forward together, naway makabalik na kami sa aming pangunahing tungkulin. Ang magservisyo at maglingkod sa ating mga kababayan. Now ay maitoon naming muli ang aming buong pansin sa paglilingkod sa ating mga kababayan lalo na sa mga higit na nangangailangan. Lastly, may the Philippine Senate remain united in fulfilling its role as the last bastion of democracy. Within these halls, may truth prevail and the true voice of the Filipinos be heard.

turns.speaker: Sen. Christopher Bong Go
turns.text: May compassion for others be a steadfast virtue. We live by in our words and in our actions. And may we, your senator judges, be instruments of your grace in the pursuit of peace, justice, and the common good. All this we ask in your holy name. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The Clerk of Court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.

Notok, na ginawa nyo talaga yung lahat ng inyong magagawa para investigahan din yung threat laban sa pangalawang Pangulo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Opo, Your Honor. Magkaiba po siya. turns.text: But you issued the subpoena against Dempsey Reyes, correct? Yes, sir. Pero ang tinanong niyo kay Dempsey Reyes yung case lang against VP Sara. Hindi niya siya tinanong ng threats to her, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, unang-una, ang ini-establish namin, ang focus ng investigation namin, the reason why we subpoenaed the late Demsi Reyes, is whether or not ba yung Vice President doon sa statement niya

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: niya na nag-contract na siya ng tao para patayin si BBM, si Liza Marcos, at si former Speaker. Sir, iyon po iyong focus

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Marcos, The offended parties in this case, if at all, are BBM, FL, and the former speaker, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Did you subpoena any of them?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Did they appear before the NBI?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: No, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Nakausap niyo ba sila ng personal? No, sir. And yet, you concluded that they were victims of grave threats, correct? Based

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: on the evidence we've gathered, yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: So without any personal correspondences with them, you— Atty. The

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: evidence is clear. According

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: to you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, I move that—

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Your Honor, I move that defense counsel, with all due respect, be admonished from stating those unprofessional remarks. We are in front of national TV. If you are not satisfied with his answer, please don't put any value to what the witness answered.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: This is a reminder for counsel for both parties. Kindly avoid side remarks. Henceforth, the Presiding Officer will have it stricken off the record. And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: whatever question you pose and afterwards withdraw, will likewise be stricken off from the record. So as to avoid any attempts at showmanship, usually seen on TV, But that will not be tolerated by this Impeachment Court. Counsel are

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: so reminded...

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: We will comply, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Please proceed... To clarify,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, yung NBI subpoena against VP Sara that you issued was her being a respondent, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Pero as a complainant, you did not issue...

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: We issued a letter, sir, December 2. No, no, no.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: As the complainant na siya yung... Subject naman ng threats, walang subpoena as to that effect.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Walang subpoena, Sir. So

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: in other words, hindi talaga siya naka-explain kasi what you sent out was a letter and not a subpoena.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yung letter is to inform the Vice President. Na iniimbestigahan din namin yung threat against the life niya. So, therefore, kailangan namin yung presence niya or any information na pwedeng makatulong sa investigation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yun na nga. Pero hindi niya siya sinenda ng subpoena. Isn't it that in a regular case, the prosecutor sends out the subpoena both to the complainant and to the respondent?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: The prosecutor, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yes. You're a lawyer. You know this. When you file a case before the prosecutor's office, the handling prosecutor issues out the subpoena sa parehong parties naman.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ang alam ko, during the case concert, I think nag-appear yata ang vice-presidente sa DOJ. Doon ako na-inform sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Okay, I'll move on to a new point. Let's talk about the reversal by the DOJ. Di ba? There was an initial finding on February 5 and then it was eventually reversed. Now... Would you agree with me that the rectifications that you made for the first affidavit of investigation were procedural deficiencies?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Procedural deficiencies? No, it's part of the case build-up, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: But what you added were TSNs, affidavits of your own agents, correct? Those were affidavits.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yes, but don't you consider those as procedural and not substantive?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Part of the evaluation and case build-up, yes sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright. But in effect, the substance of the case remained the same.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Walang nabago ho sa affidavit, sa una at sa pangalawa, parehas po yan. Very good. So

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: in other words, wala kang no additional discussion on the merits of the case?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: On the merits of the case, yung findings namin, hindi ho nabago yan, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright. Very good. So no additional witnesses were interviewed?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: What do you mean interviews?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Wala nang additional interviews. Kung ano yun sa first affidavit niyo, yun na rin yun sa second affidavit. Wala nang additional interviewees?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Kung I think ang naaalala ko, anim ho na media personalities ang na-interview namin at yun ho yung nag-reflect sa affidavit at the same time we tried to issue subpoena sa I think head ng ABS-CBN. I understand that, but be more responsive.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Your Honor, if I may, the witness is still in the process of answering his question.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, but the answer is not responsive. My question is very simple.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Let him finish first with all the respect, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of the counsel for the parties. Atty. Lotoc, the question was, sa pagitan ng una at pangalawang sinubmit ninyo sa DOJ, may mga testigo ba kayong dinagdag sa pangalawang ninyong submission sa DOJ? Or the witnesses are the same.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Nilakip lang iyong mga affidavit na hindi nailakip doon sa unang pagsumite?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: As far as I'm concerned, Your Honor, they are the same.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: But we will never know that for sure because you never released your first affidavit of investigation, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, I think it's in the DOJ. Ang binigay sa amin yung certification kung ano yung mga requirements na dapat namin i-comply.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Yeah, but what you attach, when you received the subpoena from the House Committee on Justice, which was used as the basis for the articles of impeachment, the first affidavit of investigation was never included.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yung nag-submit ho dyan, Your Honor, sila, Agent Kalilong, wala akong idea.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Hindi ninyo alam. All right,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: that's okay. So, I have a question about... The Affidavit of Investigation. Okay? An affidavit, or I'll just be more specific, your second affidavit of investigation was subscribed and sworn to, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: On February 10, 2025. Yes, sir. Alright. Before who?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Can I

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: check, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Witness may consult the document before him. Thank you, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel for the parties may assist him.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: we'll just confront him with our

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: own— Subscribe on SORN 2 before Assistant Director Glenn A. Ricarte, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright, so do you remember that you subscribed along with the other agents before General Ricarte now?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir. May signature kami rito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: And you did this because the first affidavit of investigation cannot be altered anymore.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: What do you mean, sir?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: An affidavit, as you know, you are a lawyer. Once an affidavit is subscribed and sworn to, it is a complete document already. Meaning, even if you take out one page or you add an annex, you already alter the meaning of that document. Will you agree with me?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Your Honor, the process is legal evaluation by the prosecutor and case build-up. So, pag nakita ko ng prosecution... Your Honor, I'm just talking

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: about the nature of the affidavit. I'm not talking about...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Lotoc, kindly answer the question. It's a general question pertaining to an affidavit in general, not this particular one.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ano yung question, Sir? Okay, an

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: affidavit, once you subscribe and swear to it, that already becomes a, if I may use the term, untouchable affidavit in such that... You cannot take out one page, you cannot alter one paragraph, you cannot add annex. Well,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think kung sinubmit niya na huyan officially sa limbawa, sa korte, hindi na huw pwede yan. Pero yung process namin, yung evaluation saka case build up, naguusap po ang prosecutor saka yung investigator. So sinasabi ng pros, pag may kulang ka, Ito, ito. So, itong unang affidavit, since may kulang sa mga attachment, ayusin nyo, baguhin nyo, i-comply nyo yung mga requirements. Since yung affidavit na yon is nakadate nung January 30, at magkukumply pa lang kami, anong nakumply namin, nag-submit kami sa DOJ and that is already February 10.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So magkaiba ho yung date. So definitely babaguhin namin yung date. Kasi nga dumaan kami sa process ng compliance. In other

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: words, when you subscribed and sworn to your January 30, 2025 affidavit, you added documents or pages to it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ang sabi ko po, sir. Ang sabi ng DOJ, may kulang kayong affidavit of authentication, may kulang kayong TSN. Yun ho yung inattach namin doon sa affidavit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Precisely. So in other words, you added documents to your January 30, 2025 affidavit? Attachments, sir. Attachments. So you admit that you added attachments to it?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Part of compliance doon sa case build-up at doon sa evaluation na requirement of the Department of Justice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright, but Mr. Wittes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: isn't it that— Your Honor, Your Honor, again, again. Can I respectfully request? Your Honor, may

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: I just

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: be allowed to proceed, Your Honor? Counsel for the respondent, let the counsel for the prosecutors finish with this observation or objection. Can

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: I make a respectful request to the defense to let the witness finish the answer before they propound the next question, Your Honor, please? For orderly proceeding, Your Honor, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Point well taken. Counsel, please proceed accordingly. And may I also remind the witness, Atty. Lotoc, kindly answer yes or no instead of yeah and nah.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir. Sorry po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: So that it's clear for our records.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel for the respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: So you admit that after you subscribe and swear, Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: January 30, 2025 affidavit, you added documents to it so that it would comply with the requirements of the DOJ. Is that what you're saying?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Attachments based on the requirement of the DOJ, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: All right. Thank you for that admission.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Just one last point on this. Can we flash the affidavit of investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: investigation? Flash page 1. This is page 13, Your Honor, of the AOI's Annex G-9, for the benefit or for the guidance of this honorable Court. The one that was flashed earlier. Tech is instructed to do so.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright, so this is the first page of the affidavit of investigation. Will you agree with me that this was not received by this particular document as is was not

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: received by the DOJ? I don't have personal knowledge. Ang inutusan ko po dyan, yung executive officers and agent on case na makipag-communicate sa Department of Justice. But you are a co-signer of this, correct? Yeah, insofar as the content of the affiliation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright. And you mean to say that you didn't cause the filing of this case with the DOJ?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Inutusan ko po ang executive officers at si Agent Trilong na sila mag-process po na dalhin yung referral na yan sa Department of Justice, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: At any rate, You're smart enough to peruse the first page and you can see that there's no received stamp appearing there too, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Received from DOJ or by DOJ? By DOJ. Again, ang makakasagot niyan, yung nag-process niyan, si Executive Officer nga namin. But based on

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: only... Again, the witness is still in the process of answering the question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, take it easy. Let the witness complete his answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Okay, Your Honor. But based as it appears only, as it appears on this document... This is part of the records and also uploaded in the Senate website already last July 12 so that the public can peruse. Annex GGG, this is page 13. Based on this document and observation, can you notice any received stamp on this document?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Based on that document, wala akong naka-stamped or received. Precisely

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: my point, that this was attached, if this was really received by the DOJ, there should have been an IDF, right, or a transmittal letter attached to this. Again, yung makakasagot po niyan, yung executive officers, Agent Kalilong, and the

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: prosecution, sir. Kasi sila wang nag-uusap siyan. Sila ang nagdala ng dokumento na yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright, I'll move on to a new point.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Now, Article 4 of... Hi.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: What is the pleasure of Senator Judge Pia Cayetano?

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Mr. President, I wanted to take the floor before the defense went to another point so I wouldn't interrupt his train of thought. The

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: lady has two minutes and may proceed when she's ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. President. My question is actually addressed to both counsels and to the witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: So the witness also happens to be a lawyer. Apat na abogado po tayo mag-uusap dito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Pero ang pakiusap ko, speak in layman's terms because we want the public to understand. Very simple question. I want to understand your appreciation of the crime of great threats. Okay? It sounds like a simple question but when I look at the elements, so explain ko din sa mga nakikinig.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Pag tinignan natin ang definition ng crime, So the prosecution must always prove yung elements of the crime. Ang

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: question ko ay, in your appreciation, dapat ba na ang supposed victim nakaramdam talaga siya ng threats? Or is it enough that the general public considers the statement threatening? Okay, so is it personal or is it a general sentiment? Now, before I proceed, gusto ko magbigay ng example para maintindihan ang mga kababayan natin. Kung magkapit-bahay, nagkapikunan dun sa bakod, tapos sabi nung isa, bubulohin ko to. Is that a grave threat? Second example, dalawang boksingero, nagka-initan, susuntukin kita. This is among two professional boxers. Is that a grave threat? Third example, police.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Sabi, bubunutan ko to ng barel. Is that a grave threat? Maybe it's just offensive. Dahil sa professional life, you shouldn't say that to a fellow police. And my fourth example is a senator. Pag sinabi niyang bibit-biting kita, kekwelyuhan kita, palalayasan kita, is that a grave threat? I'll add some details. If that is supposedly addressed to a fellow senator and she is a female senator like me, na kahit na hindi naman isa hung kilalang runner, marathoner, but a non-violent person, is that a grave threat? Well, I'll just tell you my personal opinion and then I'll tell you now. I felt that was a grave threat. So may I ask the counsel and the witness to now answer the question. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: If you may, Your Honor, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Your prosecution, po. Sen. Judge Pia, who do you want to answer first?

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Good question. Pag-iisipan ko ng matagal yan, Mr. President. I give you the decision on that one, Mr. President. Siguro prosecution kasi sila naman ang kailangan mag-prove ng case nila. And then the witness and then the defense counsel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Again, an admonition from the chair. Without stating conclusions of fact and law that again is reserved for the impeachment court, you may state your opinions with respect to... The elements of the crime of grave threats specifically identified by the Senator-Judge. And

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: if I may, Presiding Officer, feel free to interrupt them if you feel that they have crossed the line, as I will. That's why

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: I just want, I repeat my question, I want to understand your appreciation of the crime. You may...

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Ano, Mr. President? Will we allow them to cite jurisprudence? I leave it up to you. I just want to understand the appreciation kasi. What do you think?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Doon sa particular pong katanungang yun ni Sen. Judge Pia Cayetano na dapat ba may takot na naramdaman? Correct me if I'm wrong, Sen. Judge Pia? Yes. Yun taong tinatakot o subject matter ng grave threats o pampublikong pagtanggap pa na nakakatakot yung mga sinabi niya laban doon sa... Taong tinatakot niya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Siguro, a simple yes or no with a very short explanation would suffice, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Atty. Ligutan, you have two

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: minutes. Maraming

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: salamat sa Sen. Pia Caetano. Maraming salamat sa pagkakataon. Yung sagot sa tanong na iyan, yung sagot po ng prosecution, hindi po galing sa opinion ng aking mga kasama, ito po ay isang decision. No less than the Supreme Court of the Philippines. It just so happened, Your Honors, as an answer, in answer po sa tanong ni Sen. Pia Caetano, may dalawang kaso na po yung Supreme Court. Yung isa is paera versus people. Yung GR number, siguro yung mga law students, no? Mga law students? GR number 181626, May 30, 2011. The title is paera versus people. Sinabi ng Supreme Court doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Wala pong batas.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: na nagre-require na may private complainant. Ibig sabihin, hindi po required na iyong biktima mag-execute ng affidavit upang iyong akusado po ay puwedeng ma-found guilty ng grave threats. Paera v. People. But more than that, Your Honor, please. May isang kaso pa. No less than the Supreme Court of the Philippines. Sinabi roon, hindi po kailangan

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: na iyong recipient mismo nakaramdam ng takot or that sineryoso iyong pagbabanta, Your Honor. To repeat, itong sinabi ng Supreme Court: all that needs to be proven is that they were intended by the accused to have that effect. Iyong sagot sa tanong, hindi po galing sa prosecution, hindi po opinion, galing mismo sa Supreme Court of the Philippines.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: My memory aid correctly. There are only certain private crimes that need a private complainant. And most of these are personal crimes such as concubinage, adultery, seduction, abduction, rape, and acts of lasciviousness. Although these crimes are all entitled people of the Philippines versus the accused, without a private complainant, these crimes cannot be filed by the prosecutor. In court without the cooperation or affidavit of the private complainant. Counsel for respondent will please reply to the query of Senator-Judge Pia Cayetano. You also have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: All right. I will try to avoid making conclusions of fact and law, Your Honor, but I will answer in light of the facts of this case and leave it up to the discretion of this honorable court. It is our position. That the statements made by the Vice President were not threats in the first place. That's why we were categorizing it as a mere response to a Q&A, number one. Number two, it was never aimed directly at BBM, FL, and the former Speaker.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: In other words, had they not watched the video, for example, they wouldn't have known about it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: So in other words, Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: there was

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: no threats to begin with. And so even the discussion on the elements is not really applicable insofar as determining the innocence or guilt.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: of the vice president that is basically our position that is one more thing and practically we uh maintain this position all throughout our pleadings we never uh referred to that statement as threats we always say that if at all they were alleged threats but we referred to the statements of the vice president as statements as responses and even in my speech that's what i said

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: It was a response, Your Honor. That would be all, yeah.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted. Atty. Lotoc, your response to Sen. Judge Pia's question based on your investigation. You may proceed, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc

turns.text: So both grave threats and inciting seditions are felonies, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: In other words, they are not impeachable offenses, if you know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, if you mean by impeachable offenses, whether or not magkakwalify ba siya as betrayal of public trust? It's the appreciation of the judges. Your Honor, wala ko sa amin. Appreciation

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: of the judges, by that you mean the trial court judges, not the senator judges. No, since impeachment,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: impeachment court po. Yeah,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: but there's a possibility that if it's in conflict with the trial court judges' decision, then we have a problem.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Anjection or argumentative? I will withdraw that. Ang tanong

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: niyo? Ah, hindi na.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Alright. Grave threats and inciting to sedition. You said that it is not high crimes. It is a felony. Objection.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: The witness didn't say that. Misleading.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Misleading. Sustained. I'll

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: just move on to a new point, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel may proceed.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Rafi Tulfoy is recognized for his intervention.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Judge. Napag-usapan rin lang itong inciting to sedition. Nag-file ka ng kaso inciting to sedition against VP Sara based on dun sa utterances niya yung sa online presscon plus meron pa bang iba? Yes

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: po, Your Honor. Yung basis po namin, una yung utterances in October 18, 2024. And then kinumpara po namin siya sa utterances in November 23, 2024.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: So meron bang elements of sedition doon sa mga utterances niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ang elements na ini-establish po namin which is under the law is whether or not the speeches would tend to steer the people against the government.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So how

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: would you know kung mag-i-steer yun ng uprising o makukumbine sa mga tao na mag-alsa masa base doon sa utterances ng VP Sara? How did you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Pangalawa, if I may explain, sir. Pangalawa ho, if the speeches would tend to disturb the peace of the community and If the speeches would tend to undermine public safety...

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: So how would you know if it will tend to disturb or undermine the peace and order of the community? Paano mo malalaman based doon sa utterances niya?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: The fact ko na nag-issue ng statement yung mga government agencies tasked to protect national security at ang sabi ko nila that's an active threat, that's an issue of national security, so definitely na-disturb ko yung ating... How? Well, nag-alala ho ang nasa gobyerno. Kami ho, per se, yung sabi ko kanina… Nag

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: -alala kayo o nag-alala yung taong bayan? Kasi iba yung nag-aalala kayo, kayo nasa gobyerno, kayo naging bisiga versus nag-aalala yung nakarinig at yung mga at that time ay nagsusubaybay doon sa mga sinasabi ng BP. Nag-alala

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: po ang taong bayan, definitely.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: How?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, marami ho kami nakita sa news. Sa comments ng social media.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Comments. So that means you factored in yung comments and reactions sa social media doon sa ginawa niyang press conference, doon sa mga utterances niya kung ano yung reaction ng mga netizens na nakapanood.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: At ano naman yung mga sinabi doon?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, yun nga.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yung iba nag-worry ano na ba yung mangyayari sa bansa natin, bakit magulo yung mga nasa taas. Ang iba nagsasabi, ano ba ito? Saan ba ito patungo? So

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: hindi pa rin seditious yun. Nag-worry lang sila saan patungo. Ang seditious is, tama ka dyan BP Zarat. Go-go tayo. Gawin natin yan. Nasa likod niyo kami. Yun yung sedition.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Meron nung ganun na comment din po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Meron?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Meron po. In fact, doon…

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Ano yung

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: comment na yun? Kung meron.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yung supporter po ng…

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Ano ang sinabi?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Na… Yung nga, yung sa people power, yung sa nasa likod mo kami, kung ano yung... Nasa

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: likod mo kami, people power, nabanggit yun sa comment section.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Sa ano, Your Honor, during interview with the Vice President, doon sa November 23, 2024.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: So, meaning, binase mo, isa doon sa mga reasons kung bakit ka nag-file ng kasong sedition, base sa kaniyang utterances, dahil finactor-in mo iyong mga comments noong mga nakapanood?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Iyong sinasabing supporters?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Kasi pag sinabi ng mga nagko-comments, 'Nag-worry kami,' I don't think nandoon iyong elements of sedition. Maliban na pag sinabi na, 'Nasa likod mo kami. Let's do it. Go, go, go. Gagawin namin kung anong gusto mong gawin,' things to that effect.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Was there? Were there? Comments like those? Meron na kami nakita sa mga Facebook comments, although hindi siya nasama, na hindi siya nasama dito sa investigation. At ano nga ulit, alimbawa? Yung mga Facebook comments, Your Honor, na nagsasabi, oh, lusubin na natin ang Malacanang, tapos may ganun na sign.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Lusubin na natin ang Malacanang. Yan

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: yung comments sa Facebook, yung mga nag-comment. At

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: meron kang ebidensya tungkol diya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Hindi mo ito haka-haka lang?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Kung babalikan ko po, iyon nga po ang sabi ko: during those times, siyempre nagba-browse ho kami. Iyon nga lamang, hindi namin naisama sa authentication.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: No further questions, Your Honor. Thank you, Senator-Judge Raffy Tulfo. The Senate President is recognized. He has two minutes as well.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. On the same topic, on inciting to sedition, Atty. Lotoc,

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Meron ba kayong nakausap na mga tao na naniwala doon sa sinasabi ni Vice President Sara on inciting to sedition? Nakita ko kasi doon sa grave threats, marami kayo in-interview. Pero in this particular case, meron ba kayong at least man lang nakausap na mga tao, inimbestiga further, kung talagang merong epekto iyong kanyang mga sinabi?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So far as the cybercrime division is concerned, Your Honor,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Hindi ho kami nakapag-focus diyan. Siguro ang puwedeng makasagot niyan, Your Honor, iyong intelligence service po namin diyan sa issue na iyan. Hindi kami nakapag-focus diyan to conduct investigation on people's comments.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Para sa akin kasi, sa kabilang banda, puwede kang magsalita, pero sa kabilang banda, may naniniwala ba sa iyo? So ang gusto kong malaman, kung meron kayong nakausap na mga grupo o anyone, o naimbestigahan ninyo kung naniniwala talaga doon sa kaniyang pinagsasabi.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think ang makakasagot po niyan, iyong intelligence service, iyong director po namin, sir. Sa kaniya po iyong pool ng information.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And then I believe na doon sa mga sinabi niya, nangyari rin ito doon sa two-hour video. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pinatawag ninyo rin itong mga media personalities. Tinanong ninyo ba sa kanila kung

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Meron sa kanilang naniwala na itong mga sinabi ni Vice President ay inciting to sedition? Dapat naniwala ba sila na iyong mga sinabi ni Vice President during the two-hour video ay pinag-aalsa iyong mga nandoon? O naniniwala they

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: believe that that is

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: the theme of what he said?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Not specifically inciting to sedition. Their comments were that they were

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Na-shock sila. May comment sila doon na nasa is

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: nasa real battle mode na siya. May comment siya doon na totoo na ito, seryoso na iyong galit niya. serious.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: He is really angry

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: but inciting to sedition is to rise. There

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: is no such comment during the Q&A portion, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And just to... On a related question, Mr. Presiding Officer, exciting solicitation is serious rin. At kailangan din ito ng attention ng mga intelligence agencies natin. Meron ba kayong coordination with our iba't-ibang intelligence agencies tulad ng National Security Council, ng PNP, ng NBI, not NBI, but ng ibang mga... Security Intelligence Agencies natin, nag-coordinate bang NBI sa kanila? Kayo mismo nag-coordinate ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ang nag-uusap po dyan, Your Honor, is kasi intelligence matter yan. Ang nag-uusap po yan between intelligence service ng NBI, intelligence units ng AFP. Atty. G.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: department ng PNP. So nasa level po nila iyon, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Katulad ng grave threats, pagkakontrata; inciting to sedition, seryoso rito. Gusto kong malaman kung merong effort na ginawa ang NBI para makipag-coordinate sa AFP o sa PNP, dahil ito ang pinag-uusapan natin: pag-aalsa o hinihimok mong mag-alsa. Meron bang ganoong coordination na ginawa ang inyong opisina o ang NBI? Ang

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: alam ko meron yan, pero nasa level na po yan ng intelligence service namin, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted. Under the records, we thank the distinguished Senate President. What is the pleasure of Senator-Judge Legarda?

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Mr. President, Mr. Presiding Officer, just a few questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: The lady has two minutes. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: This is just to provide clarity.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: For this representation, and just a few questions to Atty. Lotoc.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes. Atty. Lotoc, sa paragraph 53 ng affidavit of investigation na iyong pinirmahan, sabi ninyo po that the Vice President's statements were brought about or motivated by unpleasant circumstances occurring before the November 23, 2024 press conference.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I believe, nabasa ko po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Kasama ba ho dito yung pahayag ng Vice Presidente nung Oktubre 18, 2024? Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: It's a

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: part of your affidavit.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Opo, Your Honor. Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Bago naman po magsimula ang press conference noong November 23, mayroon mga pangyayaring kasama ang Chief of Staff, si Atty. Zuleika Lopez,

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: na may kinalaman sa mga na-cite in contempt sa Kamara, detention—

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Medical emergency at mga planong paglilipat.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Ah, hindi pa po ako tapos. Sorry po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: ng piitan sa Correctional Institute for Women sa Mandaluyong.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Tama po ba na mga pangyayaring ito ay naganap

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: ilang oras bago iyong ginawang press conference na ipinakita ilang beses sa video?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Kasama po yan sa investigation namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Kahapon po, sinabi po ng testigo kayo po na kinonsider ng NBI yung so-called bigger picture. I think those were the words that you used. Sabi niyo pa, you put all the pieces of the puzzle together. In your own words.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, your honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes. Para malinaw lamang sa Impeachment Court, trying to absorb everything, saan po yatang bahagi ng affidavit of investigation nakasaad iyong mga factual findings ng NBI tungkol sa mga pangyayari noong November 22 and 23 bago iyong press conference? I was perusing the affidavit of the investigation. And I could not find the detailed circumstances leading to November 23 where where, admittedly, there was emotions, like like an emotional hyperbole or an outburst but the events leading to the press conference. San po yun sa inyong affidavit?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think, Your Honor, nasa affidavit of transcription po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: I read it a few times. I could not see the detailed events leading to that. Having mentioned the medical emergency, the transfers to the Correctional Institute for Women, and so that the person who will read the affidavit will have a factual, and complete appreciation of the events leading to the press conference. Perhaps your view, having been the person who filed the complaint, may have a different, perhaps, appreciation from my view because I find it somewhat incomplete. And that is just my comment on this because You clearly said you put all the pieces together. And during that time, alam ba ninyo na habang sinasagawa ng NBI ang investigasyong ito, may nakabimbin na direct assault, resistance and disobedience to authority, at grave coercion laban sa Vice President kaugnay iyong insidente na nangyari sa hospital, sa Veterans Medical Center?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Narinig ko lang po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes, you heard about that. Yes. And was there an investigation that was done regarding that incident?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think ang focus po namin, Your Honor, is yung violation ng great threats by the Vice President and inciting to sedition. Now, pagdating ho doon sa nangyari sa Vice Presidente,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yun nga sabi ko, hindi ako aware sa kabuan ng facts na yon. Baka yung ibang agency nag-imbestiga po doon. Hindi ako aware, Your Honor, doon

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: And so,

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: would the answer, Atty. Lotoc, be a no? Were these taken into consideration in the investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Or would

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: this be a yes, meaning it is contained in the affidavit which I'm trying to look for as well?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Actually,

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: ilang beses ko po binasa yung affidavit and what I see is there was A focus on the October 18. But on all the events on November 22 and 23, the detailed events leading to the emotional outburst did not seem complete. And that's what I'm trying to elicit from Atty. Lotoc, our witness, because when we say that we had considered the bigger picture, All the facts and circumstances leading to the cases of great threat and inciting to sedition that were recommended, we want to understand the whole process and the factual context in which it happened. Because if you are to take snapshots of events and focus on October 18 and the press conference, It can shock any person. However, if you see as well the events leading to the emotions and the detention of the chief of staff and the vice president herself, iba pa yung kasong ito, iba pa yung naditina, iba pa yung sinampang kaso at pinagsarahan ng pinto ng ambulansya, kaya nagkaroon ng kasong ganon. I tried.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: to read the affidavit a few times and could not find such a comprehensive enumeration of facts by the NBI, and that's why this query.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Puwede na po, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Meron hong affidavit of transcription kung anong nangyari, and then nag-submit po kami ng authenticated na video para makita ng mga Senator-Judges natin

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: kung what happened during those dates, for appreciation po ninyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So makikita ko rito kung ano yung nag-took place during the November 23, 2024 online press conference. But then again, as I've said, at in-explain ko na rin ito kahapon, Your Honor, if I may. Kinonsider namin yung situation ni Atty. Zulaica Lopez. Nakita namin yung complaint niya, yung reklamo niya, yung health condition na sinasabi niya. Sinama din po namin yun ano ba yung nangyari.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Taking all the situations or the facts and circumstances attendant to that event,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Hindi ho na-alter yung the fact na nag-alter ang Vice President ng grave threats against the three. Despite of the fact na merong emotional situation na ganoon. Hindi rin ho na-alter na merong violation na ginawa yung Vice President during that online press conference. And as a matter of fact, even before that emotional situation,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Malinaw ho doon sa utterances, even before that emotional situation, sinasabi ho doon sa utterances, 'Meron na akong kinausap.' So nag-trigger na ho iyon, ma'am. Meron na akong kinausap na isang tao para patayin ang Presidente, ang First Lady, at iyong Speaker of the House. So kahit sinama po namin siya to consider everything, again, Your Honor, hindi ho nabago iyong ginawa ng Vice President. Hindi rin ho nabago na iyong instruction niya is relentless in killing the three.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Atty. Lotoc, what I've been trying to ask is not just just the utterances which we've watched several times, but all the events leading to the utterances. And that is what I want. I understand what you're saying that there were... attachments or transcription. But the transcription would not be considered an assessment or an investigation. These were perhaps attached as transcription. And you earlier said that the threats are circumstantial. And that is the reason why I was looking for that in the affidavit of the investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: In short, para pong nakulangan ako, pero kung sinabi ninyong in-attach ninyo iyong transcript, so be it. But then, if you will read the fifty-plus pages again of your investigation, it seemed to me, at least at this point, that snapshots were taken focusing on October 18 and the utterances. But there seem to be events leading to it that may not have been included.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: With the indulgence of Senator-Judge Legarda, kindly wind up, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Yes. So the last question, thank you Mr. Presiding Officer. Na-interview rin niyo po ang mga membro ng media and you asked them factual information. Did you also ask them about the emotional state?

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: ng mga kalahok sa media, iyong mga pangyayaring naganap bago ginawa iyong mga naturang pahayag. In short, not just the factual statement, but the atmosphere, the events leading to that Zoom press conference that led to the perceived or alleged utterances.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Wala po iyan sa minutes of meeting, sa Q&A. Wala po iyan, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Should you not have asked the members of media and the others who were part of that so that you would have in your own words sir the complete picture so that everything is taken into consideration on why such a highly placed person would give such utterances because such conditions existed that might have just might have elicited it but you did not do that investigation or at least conversations with the members of media, I leave it at that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Loren Legarda
turns.text: Thank you for answering my questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Legarda. Senator Judge Pangilinan, you're recognized. Yes, thank you, Mr. President. And you

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: may proceed when

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: you're ready. A few questions on inciting to sedition. Yes, Your Honor. For the witness, kasi pinapaliwanag mo yung sinasagot mo yung tanong ni Senate President Winn kanina, no? Nasa NBI ka na Cybercrime Division since 2018.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: naalala mo ba yung kaso ni Ronell Mas? Yung taga Zambales na nagkaroon ng Facebook post. Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Sir. Naalala ko po pero hindi kami mahahawag ng case na yan. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: kung maalala mo dahil division ninyo ang nagsampan ng kasong inciting to sedition. Tama ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I-check ko yung record. Hindi po yata kung may hanggang. Well,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: to refresh your memory.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Nag-post siya sa social media offering 50 million to anyone who would kill former President Duterte. At that time, he was

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: the President. So, you

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
