turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: It is sealed. I move that the defense may also observe the

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: unsealing of such document. Let

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: the witness be the one to unseal it in full view of councils for both parties. Thereafter, take as instructed to kindly play. The time stamp to be identified by the counsel for the prosecutors. And

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: the time stamp is 10 minutes to 40 seconds to 11 minutes 50 seconds.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: For the record, assisting counsel for the prosecutor accompanied by assisting counsel for the respondent are

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: bringing the USB to the tech booth to be played.

turns.speaker: Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte
turns.text: And then I was asked during a press briefing.

turns.speaker: Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte
turns.text: By a

turns.speaker: Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte
turns.text: media person, if I know of these plans, if you can say the word, if that is the correct word to use here, plans. So I answered, I was asked, Romanov, and then I answered, I was told by two people, this is the first time I've heard of Romanov, so that is the third already, and I said, don't worry about my security.

turns.speaker: Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte
turns.text: If they kill me, if I die, kapag pinatay ako or kapag namatay ako, in the context of don't worry about my security. So this means, pinatay ka. Diba? Kasi hindi ka naman mamamatay by heart attack in relation to your security. Diba? So, pag namatay ako, I already asked a person to take revenge.

turns.speaker: Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte
turns.text: against three individuals.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Pause now. Mr. Witness, when did this event where the Vice President uttered those statements happen?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, November 26, 2024. That is three days after she uttered in that November 23 press conference that she already spoke to a person, and the person said yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Yes, the President and the two others. Now, Mr. Witness, what is your impression, if any, as to the emotional state of the vice president when she confirmed that, in fact, she uttered those threats?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. The witness is incompetent to answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Your Honor, I invoke Rule 130, Section 53 of the Rules of Courts. If I may read. Opinion of ordinary witnesses. General rule not allowed. But I think if we read the exception to order, it says the witness may testify, however, on his impressions of the emotion, behavior, condition, or appearance of a person. Section 53, Rule 130. The question I just posed, as to his impression, as to the emotional state of the vice president when she uttered those confirmation threats. It's in the rules, Your Honor. Comment,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor. Comment. Your Honor, the rules provide that the person should be sufficiently acquainted, Your Honor. Oh, no. And that is not the case here, so such rule does not apply. Your

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Honor. Overruled. Witness may answer if he

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: if you know. Atty. Lotoc, kindly answer if you know.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: kindly answer if you know.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. What is the emotional state of the vice president three days after November 23 when she confirmed that she uttered those statements?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, when we tried to connect that in the November 23, 2024 event and the November 26, 2024 utterances, it shows that the vice president did not joke

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: when she uttered those statements.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: At the same time, iyong pagiging furious niya at iyong pagiging fuming mad noong November 23, dala pa niya hanggang doon sa November 26, kasi ni-reiterate po niya, Your Honor, at in-admit po niya na meron siyang kinausap na tao to take revenge.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: So she admitted again, three days after?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Asked and answered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: All right. Let me proceed, Your Honor, please.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, earlier it was pointed out by the defense that now that line where the vice president said that she spoke to a person and the person said yes to kill the president and the two others, that was just in response. To a question by a certain Princess Maui. Do

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: you remember that? These

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: are just preliminary questions. This

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: is the purpose of redirect. Let's

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: move on. Let's move on, Councils. We all know what we're talking about here. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Did you consider that statement, that fact that it was only in response to Princess Maui's statement? If any, if at all.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Objection leading.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, I don't think so, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yung nature ng Atty. Frances, may kinausap na ako ma'am, wag kang mag-alala. So ibig sabihin, even before the questions was asked, may kinausap na ako ang vice-presidente base doon sa Atty. Frances niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Again, what is the significance, if any, and if you know, and if at all, that fact to your investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, it's very much significant because

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: We were able to determine the risk intent on the part of the vice president. The vice president is determined and so far as that statement is concerned.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: At the same time, the utterances were not the product of a temporary fit of anger or spur of the moment. In other words,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: the threat was real, was serious, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: You remember during cross-examination yesterday, the good counsel for the defense presented you with a diagram, using their props, that the NBI is under the DOJ. Remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: And that the DOJ is under the—

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Now, the NPS under the DOJ and the DOJ is under the President, correct? Yes, sir. In fact, you were asked point-blank whether the President, if they refer to the President as BBM, I would like to refer to our President as President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. You were asked if he intervened. Do you remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Did he, in fact, intervene—the President—in your investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. Leading.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: If you know, the witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Not at all, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: What would you say that not at all?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, wala hong dumating sa akin na any information or any direction or any directive even from the director na nakipag-communicate ang presidente sa NBI during that time na nag-iimbestiga kami.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: If you know, what is the basis of your findings? In filing the cases for grave threats and inciting to the sedition against the Vice President, if you know. I'm not sure what

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: is the...

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Basis of your findings. Objection,

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Vague?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Objection, there's an objection.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Basis of the findings? Well, as I have explained that, Your Honor, there were several factors that we considered before we come up with a conclusion. Yung una nga,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: iyong manner of delivery, or the manner in which the utterances were spoken; and then the literal meaning of the statement—in-explain ko na rin ho iyan; and then the nature of the instruction na relentless: 'Huwag kang tumigil hangga't hindi mo mapapatay sila.'

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: As well as the relationship between the parties involved, meaning the Vice President and the President, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Thank you so much. Now, earlier,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: The counsel for the defense, in their argument that it was merely an exercise of the freedom of expression of the Vice President when she uttered that, said that the Vice President is an ordinary citizen. Do you remember that? Objection, leading. I think

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: so, Your Honor. Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Honor, again, this is the purpose of the Directs.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Do you agree with that? That the Vice President is an ordinary individual?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Definitely not, Your Honor. The Vice President is the second highest official of the land, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay. Now, let's proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, yesterday, the defense devoted more than two hours in pointing, for example, number one, an alleged discrepancy in the subpoena.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay. Dated November 6, 2024. And according to the defense, the NBI supposedly started its investigation on November 23. But there was already a subpoena dated November 6. Do you remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, how do you characterize this error, if

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: at all? Typo, sir. Typographical error, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Typographical. Para maintindihan ng ating mga kababayan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Atty. Lotoc, ano ba ibig sabihin, kung alam mo, ng isang

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: typographical error?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, basically, hindi ito substantial insofar as the document is concerned. Ito ho iyong may, for instance, maling spelling o nagkamali lang ng date. Then, pag makita mo naman doon sa surrounding circumstances, ito naman ang tinutukoy na date.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Gaya ng mga case numbers.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Case numbers. Now, what effect, if any, did this typographical error have on the statement of the vice president threatening the president and the two others? What's the effect, if any, of

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: these errors? They don't have any effect at all insofar as the findings of the NBI is concerned. Why

turns.speaker: Rep. Lorenz R. Defensor
turns.text: is that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, because those typographical errors does not alter the fact that the video exists. It does not alter the fact that the Vice President uttered those statements. And it does not alter the fact that the findings of the NBI is that the Vice President committed the crime of great threats and inciting to sedition. Okay, now.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: The defense also mentioned that there is a lack of signature of Atty. Ria Asuncion on one of the several minutes of the interview, this time with a certain Jason Rubrico of SM&I. How do you characterize that error again, if you know? Typo error. What

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: effect, if any, does that typo error have on the statements? At the vice president threatening the president and the two

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: others. Again, sir, hindi ho nabago yung utterances ng vice presidente. Hindi rin ho nabago yung video. Hindi rin ho nabago yung findings namin na indeed kumpleto yung mga ebidensya at ang presidente ay nag-commit ng crime of great threats and inciting to sedition.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay, third point. What about the alleged discrepancy in docket numbers? How do you characterize

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: that error? Objection, Your Honor. The witness already testified during cross-examination that he was not privy to the assignment of docket numbers as that is the function of the DOJ. So he won't be in court. Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Your Honor, I do remember. Despite that, counsel asked several questions after that, and the witness was able to answer those questions.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, he mentioned that he does not have personal knowledge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Counsel, if he gives a different answer, then you can address that in your recross. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: This discrepancy in the docket numbers, how do you characterize this error?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Your Honor—

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. He won't be competent to answer that because docket numbers are assigned by the DOJ, not by the NBI.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: that's the point. Again, counsel, let him answer. If he answers that he's not competent, then that's his answer. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, kung docket number lang ho ang pag-uusapan, hindi ho nawala yung existence ng video.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Hindi rin ho nabago na ang Vice President ay nagsalita na meron na siyang kinausap na tao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: your answer is not responsive though. Kindly answer the question of the council.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay, how do you characterize that error? Typographical error. Okay, next question. What effect, if any, does that typographical error have on the statements of the Vice President threatening the President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., His Excellency, and the two others?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: No effect at all, Your Honor. Hindi ko na-alter yung utterances ng Vice Presidente. Okay, now,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: let's go to the affidavits of investigation which the Good Counsel mentioned in yesterday's cross-examination. During your cross-examination, you were asked questions concerning the January 30, 2025 affidavit of investigation. After that, affidavit was admitted. Now, the question is, what action, if any, Did the Department of Justice take, and if

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: you know? The Department of Justice evaluated the referral by the NBI. And then after evaluation, nag-issue po sila ng certification na kulang pa, insufficient yung inyong sinubmit. So dapat i-comply niya muna itong mga requirements na to. So nagbigay po sila ng, I think seven po ang nandoon. Yung po ang ginawa ng Department of Justice.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Alright. Now, what did the NBI do, if any, in response to that recommendation from the DOJ? The

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: NBI complied the requirements of the Department of Justice. And as a matter of fact, nung na-comply na ho namin, the DOJ issued a certification stating to the effect You have complied all the elements of the crime charge and you are now good for preliminary investigation, sir. In

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: fact, you also remember yesterday that you mentioned that the NBI also submitted a letter to DOJ. Do you remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Why did the NBI submit a letter to the DOJ, if you know?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, I think that letter was signed by the then Director Jaime Lee Santiago. And the then Director was notifying the Department of Justice that the NBI has already complied with all the requirements and that the NBI is now submitting its affidavit with all the requirements attached therein and with explanation specifically yung requirement na kailangan may complaint ang recipient gaya ng Presidente. Ang explanation doon sa letter na yon na for purposes of preliminary investigation under the new NPS rules, hindi ko kailangan yung complainant himself, kundi pwede ang law enforcement agency kaya ng NBI na mag-file na complaint. Again, for purposes of preliminary investigation.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Atty. Lotoc, if shown a copy of that letter of former Director Santiago, will you be able to identify the same? Yes, sir. Now, we are now in the process through Atty. Steven Magallon of Saligalo, showing you a copy of a letter dated February 11, 2025. We invite the defense to also peruse the same. Yes, sir. Also, assisted by a lawyer also from Cebu. What relation, if any, does this document have with the one you mentioned?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: The same docs that I mentioned, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Your honors, at this juncture we move that the letter dated February 11, 2025 by Director Santiago identified by the witness where the NBI informed the DOJ that it already complied with all the requirements. Be marked as exhibit P-Roman numeral 4-34 for the prosecution.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: This is not yet premarked, counsel. Not

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: yet premarked. Introduced in response to the cross-examination by the defense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Comment from the counsel for respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: We do not object. No comment.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: do not object, Your Honor. Just a photocopy, Your Honor. The comment is that the document is a photocopy. That's what

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: I was

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: waiting for.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Counsel may proceed.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Right on cue, we have a certified true copy of the same. We invite the defense.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Assisting counsel for the respondent, kindly confirm.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: May we have a stipulation from the defense?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Is the photocopy a faithful reproduction of the original or certified true copy presented by the assisting counsel for the prosecutor?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: For the record, Your Honor, it's a photocopy.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Is it a certified true copy, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: It is a certified true copy.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Compared with a photocopy, so we are moving for a stipulation that the photocopy is a faithful reproduction of the certified true copy of the same document.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Same manifestation, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Noted.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: All right. Now, Mr. Witness, which part of the attached letter did the NBI explain that no law requires the offended party to execute a complaint to conduct preliminary investigation for grave threats?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think... First page, the last paragraph, which says: It is to be emphasized that under the 2024 New Rules on Preliminary Investigation and Inquest Proceedings, a law enforcement agency like the NBI can file a complaint for the purpose of preliminary investigation unless the crime to be filed falls under Section 5, Rule 110 of the Rules of Criminal Procedure.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay. Thank you so much. May proceed, Your Honor?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, Counsel.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, you were asked whether the NBI already identified the particular individual contracted by the President, sorry, by the respondent, the Vice President, to kill the President and the two others. Okay? Do you remember that? Yes, sir. Now, to clarify, for the record, what investigation, if any, did your own? Your own NBI Cybercrime Division conducts on this matter, if any, if you know. Again, again, sir. Okay. You were asked whether the NBI already identified the particular individual contracted by the respondent to kill the president and the two others. And you said you remember

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: that. Objection, Your Honor, on the use of the word contracted. We never said contracted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Reform Council.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: The Vice President already spoke to a person to kill the President and that person said, yes, so that's a contract. Now, do you remember that? Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Now, it's a conclusion of law made by the Council for the Prosecution. Witness

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: may answer. Alright, now, to clarify, sorry, this is now the question, Atty. Lotoc, to clarify for the record, what investigation? Did your own NBI Cybercrime Division conduct on the identity of this person that said yes to the order of the Vice President to kill the President and two others?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Again, the reason why we sent a letter dated December 2, 2024 to the Vice President is for that purpose. We informed the Vice President that we are also investigating the alleged threats against her life.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Unfortunately, hindi siya nag-appear. So wala ho kaming makitang validated information. Then aside nun, we also issued a subpoena to the media personalities who were present during those press conference and who have personal knowledge na nangyari yung event na yon. And in fact, tinanong po namin din sila isa-isa. Kilala niyo ba yung kinausap ng vicepresidente? May idea ba kayo kung sino yung tao na yon? At bawat isa sa mga nasabihin na ho namin at nag-appear, sinabi nila na hindi ho namin kilala. Wala po kaming alam, Your Honor. And then, nung chineck namin yung open source, nung nagkanta kami ng open source investigation, kasi yun nga, sinasabi ko kanina, Your Honor, Tinitrace namin yung sinabi ni Princess Maui na Romanov ang nakita lang namin doon yung statement ni Mayor Baste noong January 2024 Tinindan din namin kung relevant ba yung pag-aalis ng 75 PNP personnel from the BPSPG at inilipat sa Manila para doon sa Peace and Security i-augment yata sila Atty.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Sidder din ho namin yon, pero wala ho kaming na-validate na information relative to the threat against the life of the Vice President. But ganun pa man, Your Honor, I know for a fact na yung aming intelligence service ay continue hong nagmamonitor at nagahanap kung sino yung tao na yan. Baka ho sila ang pwedeng sumagot o yung aming director, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, Atty. Lotoc. Let's move to another point now. In your investigation, Atty. Lotoc, what significance, if any, did the NBI give to respondent's own admission that she already spoke to a person to kill the president and the two others? What significance, if any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, mabigat ho iyon kasi lumalabas na hindi lang ho siya nag-joke noong ni-reiterate niya iyon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Ibig sabihin, may intention doon ang vice-presidente, base doon sa mga utterances na iyon, pinag-isipan niya yan. In fact, I can classify it as—

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. The answer is already based on his own interpretation. May we move, Your Honor, that it be stricken from the record?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Whose interpretation should he be answering? Witness will please complete his answer, and then the Chair will consider the objection of counsel for respondent.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor. Yun nga sinasabi ko, it was contemplated, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay. Now, Atty. Lotoc—

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: move to strike it off the record considering that he included conclusions of law in his answer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: I mean, you have been asking questions on the basis of law and we did not complain. Now I'm asking question to him as a lawyer. Counsel, please,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: motion is denied. Let it remain in the record for whatever purpose it may serve. Let the senator judges give it its due weight according to their discretion. Witness, rather counsel may proceed. Thank you so much.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, you were also asked about the NBI's alleged lack of coordination with certain government agencies such as the PNP, the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and the National Security Council in its investigation of the threats to the President and the two others. Do you remember being asked that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. It was not covered by my cross-examination. It was a query from one of the Senator-Judges.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: In the discretion of the court, the counsel can ask questions not covered by the cross-examination. We'll allow it.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Now, could you explain to the court how is this so, if you can?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: In so far as communication with other agencies, the cybercrime division back then, nakafocus ko kami sa investigation aspect. Now, pagdating doon sa security ng...

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: highest officials. Again, for a fact, I know na may ginagawa yung aming intelligence service and so for us, communicating with other relevant agencies gaya ng AFP, PNP, PCO, and even National Security Council. Yun nga lang, yun sa amin, Your Honor, nakafocus kami dun sa investigation. Ngayon, kung may binababaho ang director, base sa mga informasyong nakalap niya from different agency, mag-i-instruct po siya sa amin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Alright. Now, let me proceed. Mr. Lotok, you were asked during cross-examination about the investigation that you conducted on the alleged threats to the life of the Vice President. You were asked whether there was an affidavit of investigation report on such investigation that you conducted. And you answered there was none. Correct? You remember having said that there is no affidavit of investigation? For the Vice President? For the Vice President. Yes, sir. And you said that there was an investigation but there is no affidavit of investigation. The question now is, so whatever happened, what happened to that investigation?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, since wala ho kaming ma-establish na validated information, hindi ho gaya dito nung sa Presidente na may apparent commission of crime, dito ho kasi wala kami mapagsimulan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Hindi kami pwedeng mag-produce ng Affidavit of Investigation, if that's the case. Ang ginawa namin, although nagaantay kami ng validated information at nangangalap kami, continue na nagmo-monitor yung aming intelligence service. I know that for a fact kasi yun yung trabaho nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Siguro ho, pag sila ang tinanong natin, baka meron silang masabi kung ano yung nangyari dyan, ano yung update niyan, maging ho ang aming director.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Alright now, but Mr. Witness, you were also confronted with the fact that a certain Princess Maui mentioned in that press conference a certain Operation Romanov that allegedly Is a security threat to the Vice President. Do you remember that? Yes, sir. Now, what did you do, if any, on this information?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yeah, security threat. Ang nakita naming relevant dyan, yun nga po, yung pag-aalis ng 75 personnel sa BPSPG, then nilipat dun sa Manila. Then aside from that, basi ho kasi sa... Record ng COA, meron pa rin

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: pa ring 335, more or less, na naiwan na security personnel ng Vice President. At ang narinig ko yata kay Honorable—iyong sa comment noong Ombudsman na ba siya noon o Secretary of Justice siya—na iyong number na iyan ay mas malaki pa sa bilang ng security personnel ng Presidente.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: I'm referring, Mr. Witness, to Operation Romanov.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Bacquel Okay, what did you do, if any, on that information offered by Princess Mau, information on Operation Romanov?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection? Asked and answered. That was his answer in the previous question. Alright, alright,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: alright. Now, what

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: else? What else did you do, if any, in relation to the investigation, your investigation on the security threat to the Vice President?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Paulit-ulit kong sinasabi, yung open source, we trace, ang ano yung mga relasyon nung security threats. Yung Romanov na yan, uulitin ko, narinig namin yan first time sa bibig ni Mayor Baste during my Easter rally in January 2024. And so far, and so far as the NBA is concerned, during that time, nung ako yung jepe, Wala ho kaming na-establish na validated information vis-a-vis yung threat to life against the vice president, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay, now, you also mentioned that you issued a subpoena to the Vice President and a letter asking her to shed light on the threats she said she was facing. You remember having mentioned that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay now, again, what was the response? At the vice president to the NBI's official investigation to her to appear before it to shed light on the threats she was complaining about.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: What is it, counsel?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: That is misleading, your honor, because the subpoena was for her to answer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: I think he mentioned letter, counsel. I heard letter, if I'm not mistaken.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Let's focus on that letter, if you may.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, I think that was the December 2, 2024 letter, if I'm not mistaken. And then nag-reply ho sila ng letter. At sinabi po doon ng lawyers na the Vice President is confident that the NBI will also investigate. The alleged threat against her life. Yun po

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: yung terror

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: nung letter na yun sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Mr. Witness, you also mentioned that since the Vice President did not heed the letter you issued, you were not able to elicit information from her. You remember having said that, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: However, on the part of the threats to the life of the President and the two others, you did not need to interview them personally to proceed with the investigation. Remember having said that? Yes, sir. Now, the question now is for clarification before our honorable senator judges, what's the difference? Why the difference between the two?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Ulitin Kapo, Your Honor, insofar as the threat against the life of the Vice President, we have not established a validated information that remains to be allegation. Insofar as the threat based on the utterances against the President, the First Lady, and the former Speaker of the House. That was apparent. Nasa video, narinig ho namin. Therefore, based sa aming jurisdiction, which is primary jurisdiction, kaya ho kami nag-imbestiga kaagad doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Okay, three more points, Your Honor, before the prosecution winds up its redirect. Now, it was also raised during the discussion during cross-examination. That the vice president was merely exercising her freedom of speech and she was not committing a crime of inciting to sedition. Do you remember being confronted with that issue? Yes, sir. Now, you tell the honorable court what is your response to that issue, if any?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, your honor. It will call for his opinion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Exactly. He's a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Opinion, Your Honor. He's not an expert on the matter. He's a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Witness may answer if he knows.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, I've already said, Your Honor, to reiterate, if the second highest official of the land uttered openly and in public that she had already contracted a person to kill the President, the First Lady, the former Speaker of the House, and she instructed that person to be relentless in killing them, and that person said, yes, we failed to see any amount.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: 2. Should we allow that kind of argument, should we allow that to become the norms of our society, then nobody would prevent from anyone from doing the same. Imagine the chaos, the disorder and the anarchy, Your Honor. 3. As a lawyer and being in the law enforcement, freedom of speech protects lawful expression. But it does not protect utterances that satisfies the elements of a criminal offense like this one, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: A criminal offense like this one. Now, as a lawyer, Atty. Lotoc, when the Vice President uttered in public that she already spoke to a person to kill the President, the First Lady, and the two others—

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: As a lawyer, did the Vice President betray public trust?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. That will call for a conclusion of law already. And as a lawyer, it will call also for his personal opinion.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: The Council will propound the questions on also issues of law felony versus crime. What is the penalty? I'm also asking the same line of questions, Your Honor. What is sauce for the goose should also be sauce for the gander, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: A similar question was asked by the Council for the respondent and the witness may answer if he knows. If he knows.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor, as a lawyer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: She betrayed public

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: trust. Yes, Your Honor. Last question.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: Atty. Lotoc,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: As a matter of law,

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: if the President, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is killed, God forbid, who assumes the presidency?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. The Vice President. Speculative. Ashkahn answered. The Vice President.

turns.speaker: Atty. Amando Virgil D. Ligutan
turns.text: No more redirect, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Before recognizing counsel for respondent for recross, the Chair would like to recognize Senate President Gatchalian for his interjection. You may proceed, sir, and you have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Atty. Lotoc, napakinggan ko kanina iyong isang sagot ninyo at sinabi ninyo dito just this afternoon:

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Yes, we do believe that the Vice President had contracted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Naputo lang siya but obviously contracted someone to...

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: commit a crime or to kill the President and the others. Kahapon, narinig ko na ipinapasa nyo sa investigative division ng inyong or intelligence service ng inyong ahensya itong tanong na ito. So, ano ba? Meron bang nakontratang papatay o walang nakontratang papatay?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Dahil this morning lang sinabi niyo, you believe na merong nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Basi ho doon sa utterances, we believe the Vice President na hindi ho siya nagbibiro nung sinabi niya yun. So ang standpoint namin, meron na ho siyang kinausap na tao.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Anong ebidensya na meron kayo o meron ka o meron yung Cybercrime Division na made you believe na merong nakontrata?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Una, Your Honor, kung iyong pagbabasihan po namin is iyong November 23 na may kinausap siya, puwede hong sabihin na nag-joke lang siya doon kahit galit na galit siya or etc. But then, noong na-incorporate po natin iyong November 26, ni-reiterate pa niya at sinabi niya doon openly and in public na totoo, may kinausap na siya to take revenge if she dies. Our belief is that the Vice President talked to someone.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Now, insofar as kung sino iyong kinausap na iyon, and insofar as iyong existence ng tao na iyon, ang makakasagot po noon, Your Honor, since trabaho nila iyon, iyong aming intelligence service po o kaya iyong aming director.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So your

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: belief came from the statements of

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Vice President Sara?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. No

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: more. Statements and admission, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So doon lang nanggaling? Wala nang iba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: In so far as the Cybercrime Division, Your Honor, yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Okay. And then, meron din siyang reply. Sinabi niyo nga kanina, nagpadala kayo ng letter.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Dated... December

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: 2, Your Honor. December

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: 2. And may reply rin si VP na dine-deny niya na merong grave threat. So pag dine-deny niya na ginawa niya ang grave threat, obviously, dine-deny niya na may...

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So, bakit pa rin ninyo i-file or re-recommend na mag-file ng grave threat in inciting to sedition kung may denial na?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Hindi ho, Your Honor. Ang na-establish po namin doon iyong elements of the crime of grave threats. So, noong nakita namin na na-satisfy at na-comply iyon, noong na-refer po namin ito sa Department of Justice—

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Nag-concur sa amin ang Department of Justice na indeed na-comply namin, and therefore tuloy iyong proseso ng preliminary investigation.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: But what made

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: you not... Bakit hindi ninyo tinanggap itong paliwanag ni VP Sara sa kanyang letter? Dahil kaagad dito sa letter niya may denial na ginawa niya yung grave threat and therefore wala rin na kontrata kasi magkadugtong yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, Your Honor... Mere denial would not discount the fact na na-atter niya yon at may kinausap na siyang mga tao. Yun nga ang problema dun kaya namin siya gustong makausap personally para makapag tanong pa kami ng other questions para makita namin totoo ba tong kinontrata ng vicepresidente o kinausap o hindi. Kaya lang yung honor wala ho doon hindi ho siya nag-appear. Yung kanyang sagot is Justine

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: mere denial lang, walang mga basehan, even circumstantial na basehan. So hindi ho namin siya sinama sa factor in considering whether or not a crime of grave threat has been committed by the Vice President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: With your permission, Mr. Presiding Officer, just one last question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Nakita niyo ba kung merong capability si Vice President Sara? Definitely,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: definitely po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Ano ang nakita niyong mga ebedensya kung meron siyang capability gawin yung kanyang sinabing pagbanta at yung kanyang gagawin?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, for one, she is the Vice President of the Republic of the Philippines. And number two, hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: naman porket Vice President ka, may capability ka gumawa nun. Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Your Honor. Not necessarily. But alam naman po natin yung background. Naging presidente ang— Hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: ka naman porket Senate President. May capability ka gumawa nun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. So

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: anong-anong ebidensya na meron kayong nakita na kaya niyang gawin nun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Alam naman po natin yung background na yung tatay niya na dating presidente ay hinaharap ngayon yung kaso sa ICC dahil sa mga extrajudicial killings, etc.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So, tinignan namin yon na indeed being in that situation, may capability ho aside from the fact na vice-presidente siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Ejercito, thereafter, Senator Judge Ontiveros for their interjections. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Atty. Lotoc, given that the Vice President repeated her alleged threats, as presented kanina, sabi ninyo twice or thrice sa mga videos?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Did you consider her persistent in making the threat or in going through with the threat? Because these two are different.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. I think iyong in-explain ko po, iyan iyong nature of instruction. Kasi iyong nature of instruction niya, sabi niya doon, 'Pag namatay ako, huwag kang tumigil hangga't hindi mo mapapatay sila.'

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: So there, that's indicative of persistence, na determined din po ang Vice President na gawin iyon at pursigido siya doon sa kaniyang mga utterances, kasi maliwanag po sa instruction na, 'Hangga't hindi mo sila mapapatay, huwag kang titigil.'

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: So, hindi ba ito tinatawag na persistent lamang doon sa threat kung may mangyari sa kanya? If something happens to her, di ba? Parang yan yung nasa... Yes,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Does the heat of the moment still matter here? Kasi maaaring dahilan sa bugso ng galit o sa takot nung gabing yun nang nangyari dahil sa sitwasyon na nandun po sila sa batasan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Again, Your Honor, pwede pong mag-matter yan kung yan lang ho ang pinagbasihan namin yung November 23. 2024. Kaya lang, kaya nga ng explanation

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: explanation ko, kinonsider namin yung mga previous statements na may patterns, may consistencies, yung October 18, 2024, as well as after ng November

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: November 23, which is November 26, 2024. So marami ho ang mga factor na kinonsider namin bago kami nag-conclude na indeed. May violation ang vice-presidente.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Dahil doon po sa Atty. Lotocdo sa Israel vs. People, GR No. 265736, dated November 19, 2025, sinabi ng Korte Suprema na sa pagtukoy kung may mens rea o kriminal na intensyon, kinakailangan ding umiral ang pagpupursige or persistence. Yes, sir. Kung

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: walang ganitong pagpupursige, walang krimeng grave threats. Yes, sir. Gaya ng mga bantang binitiwan lamang sa tindi ng galit o bugso ng damdamin o bilang biro at hindi naman sinunda ng anumang kilos o karagdagang pagbabanda.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, sir. Insofar as persistence is concerned, nakita po natin yan noong November 23 utterances. At at the same time, persistence in the sense na aside doon sa November 23, inadmit po niya at nireiterate niya yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: In the November 26, 2024 statement.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Dahil meron po sa Article 282, yung threats without persistence are not considered grave. Yes, sir. So, in conclusion, Sir President Officer, sa inyong palagay, ano-anong ginawa ng Vice Presidente ang may tuturing na pagpupursige o persistence sa kanyang mga banda? Well,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Your Honor, October 18, sinabi na niya doon na I imagine myself cutting his head, na gusto kong tanggalin yung ulo niya ba. In fact, may instance doon na sinabi niya na, pag di kayo tumigil, uhukayin ko yung tatay niyo, itatapon ko sa West Philippine Sea. Meron ganun noong October 18. And then pagdating dito sa November 23,

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: She was hurling profanities and invectives habang galit na galit siya at sinasabi niya this country will go to hell dahil yung tao na yan na nakaupo hindi marunong maging presidente. Wala akong kinukonsider na mas mataas sakin. At the same time, he was lying through his teeth para lang makuha yung boto ng mga tao. And then yung nung kinausap niya na papatay sa tatlo. At the same time, ginugtong ho namin yung November 26. Inulit pa ho niya yun aside na persistence na yung nature ng kanyang utterances. Inulit pa ho niya nung November 26 openly and in public na indeed may kinausap siya to take revenge. Na kung mamatay siya, patayin niyo yung tatlo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: That's... much persistence, kung i-establish po natin iyong persistence, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joseph Victor “JV” Ejercito
turns.text: Maraming salamat, Atty. Lotoc. That's all. No further questions, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank you, Sen. Judge Ejercito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Sen. Judge Ontiveros, you may proceed, ma'am, when you're ready. You have 10 minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat, Mr. Presiding Officer. Mr. Witness.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Nabanggit niyo kay Sen. Judge Ejercito, hindi ngayon lang, kanina, iyong admission against interest.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Sabi niyo po ang mga pahayag ng vicepresidente ay maituturing na admissions against interest. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: May diferensya po ba sa pagtrato sa pahayag ng isang tao kung pabor sa kanya o against sa interest niya ang admission?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: I think so, ma'am. Kasi base dito sa issue natin, Ang vice-presidente is abogada. Alam na po niya yun na the moment she uttered those kind of statements, pwede ho siyang mag-fall in any criminal violation. So pagdating ho nung November 26, instead of avoiding mentioning those utterances, instead of denying that she made those utterances, ang sinabi po niya, nire-iterate niya. Yes, sinabi ko yan na someone has to take revenge. Kung sakaling mangyari ito, mamatay ako.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yun po, Your Honor, ang nakita namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Kaya ako nasabi na admission against interest po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So kung sa halip na i-reiterate niya, i-deny niya yung naunang sinabi, kung sinabi niya na Hindi ko talaga minimin yan or may sinabi siyang maituturing na pabor sa kanya. Iba po yung pagtrato nyo sa ganyang klaseng pahayag sana.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Baka maging iba, Your Honor. Okay.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So ano po yung diferensya at saka halaga dun sa bigat na binibigay ng batas dun sa admission against interest?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, pinapakita ko rito, in the natural order of things, hindi ho ia-admit ng isang tao yung isang bagay na ikakasira niya o na ikakaharap niya sa isang paglilites, something like that. Kapag ho inadmit ng isang tao yung isang bagay na ikakasira niya, maliwanag na ginawa niya yun, sinabi niya yun, at determinado siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: sa mga pangyayaring iyon o pursigido siya sa mga pangyayaring iyon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So, masasabi po bang mabigat o napakabigat ang halaga na ibinibigay sa ilalim ng batas sa isang admission against interest?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes. Yes, Your Honor, Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Panghuli na lang po, Mr. Witness. Bakit nga po pinaparusahan ng batas ang grave threats kahit Pa hindi na tuloy sa physical act?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Well, Your Honor, for purposes of peace and order among the populace, pag hindi ho in-address yung speeches o yung utterances na magka-qualify as grave threat, magkakagulo ho yung mga tao. Pwede na lang ho sabihin kahit na sino na papatayin kita pag ito nangyari. Gagawin ko ito sa'yo pag ito nangyari. So I think the wisdom of the law is to avoid the disorder, the anarchy, and the chaos that it would create, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So yung sinasabi niyong wisdom of the law ay hindi lamang sitahin o Pwede po yun yung

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: isang bagay na tumuloy sa physical act kundi mag-serve ng deterrent? Para gawin

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: ngayon ng

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: taong iyon o ng ibang tao

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: yung grave threats? Pwede po yun, Your Honor. To serve as a deterrent, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So may preventive na value din nakikita kayo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Bukod sa curative?

turns.speaker: Atty. Jeremy C. Lotoc
turns.text: Opo, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Salamat po, Mr. Witness. Salamat po, Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you, Senator Judge Antiveros. Senator Judge Rafi Tulfo, thereafter, Senator Judge Alan Cayetano, before the recross of counsel for respondent, if any. Senator Judge Tulfo, you may proceed and you have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Mr. Witness, aware ba kayo at one point in time, I just don't remember what date was it, na pinulled out yung certain numbers of security personnel ni BP Sara?
